source: Help Bucky gather building materials to fix the town bridge.
target: 帮助巴奇收集修缮镇上桥梁所需的建材。

source: Go find a few critters Scarlett wants you to meet.
target: 去找斯卡蕾特想让你认识的几位动物居民。

source: Find the plant and bring back some special 'seed' for Scarlett.
target: 找到那株植物，替斯卡蕾特带回一些特别的“种子”。

source: Help the coyotes knit you a cozy warm sweater.
target: 帮助郊狼们给你织一件暖和舒适的毛衣。

source: Help Maverick deliver some curious items to the forest critters.
target: 帮马弗里克给森林里的动物居民送几样稀奇的东西。

source: Trade Ollie some apples for a ride across the Plains.
target: 拿些苹果给奥利弗，换他载你穿过平原。

source: I need a new toy, but not just ANY toy, it has to NOT look like a toy. Understand?
target: 我需要一个新玩具，但绝不是随便什么玩具，它必须看起来不像玩具。明白吗？

source: Sonny, ya familiar with PlayBear? I’d love to get my paws on a copy!
target: 小伙子，听说过《玩乐熊》吗？我真想把一本弄到爪里！

source: Thanks for helping out today, Red. The critters and I really appreciate it!
target: 谢谢你今天帮忙，小红。我和动物居民们都很感激！

source: There's a rope-oriented bondage I’d like to try! Can you help me find ropes my size?
target: 我想试试用绳子玩的捆绑！能帮我找适合我尺寸的绳子吗？

source: Got some explorin’ to do! Not sure what I want yet -- but I'm sure you can help me find it!
target: 想探索点新鲜东西！我还没想好自己想要什么——不过你肯定能帮我找到！

source: What exactly is the Blessing Of The Bells? See if some of the forest critters can tell you more!
target: 鸣铃祝福节究竟是什么？看看森林里的动物居民能否多告诉你一些！

source: Help Mabel remember what really happened during her last Blessing of the Bells.
target: 帮助梅布尔回忆她上次过鸣铃祝福节时究竟发生了什么。

source: Melody has an idea where you might find an extra greeting card from last year's Blessing. See if you can track it down!
target: 梅洛迪想到哪里可能有一张去年鸣铃祝福节多余的贺卡。看看能不能找到！

source: Gather some critters for sexy shenanigans in the bunnies' downstairs dungeon.
target: 召集几位动物居民，到兔子家楼下的地牢找点色色的乐子。

source: It's the ladies' turn! Gather a few frisky females for more shenanigans in the bunnies' downstairs dungeon.
target: 这次轮到女士们啦！召集几位兴致正浓的女士，到兔子家楼下的地牢继续找点色色的乐子。

source: Maverick's been harvesting Oliver's seed and carrying it away. But why? And why does he need so much?
target: 马弗里克一直在收集奥利弗的种子，还把它们带走了。为什么？他又为什么需要那么多？

source: Help Finley close the loop with his old roommates.
target: 帮芬利和旧室友把以前的事妥善收个尾。

source: Deliver cookies from Charlotte to all the forest critters.
target: 把夏洛特的曲奇送给森林里所有的动物居民。

target: 昨天的大风暴过后，去看看动物居民们怎么样了！

target: 和梅布尔的部落一起举行古老的仪式，平息“森林之灵”。

target: 追踪难觅踪影的狼，为鼠族仪式收集一种重要的材料。

While you're playing an Adventure, your other quests are stored in the background.

You'll see them again when the Adventure is finished!

进行冒险时，其他任务会暂存在后台。

冒险结束后，你就能再次看到它们！

target: 想办法收集漂在水上的浮木。
